function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

1. Honolulu, Hawaiʻi  
   • Zone name: Hawaii–Aleutian Standard Time (HST)  
   • UTC offset: UTC −10:00 year-round  
   • Daylight-saving time (DST): Never observed  

2. New York, USA  
   • Zone name: Eastern Time  
     – Eastern Standard Time (EST)  = UTC −05:00  
     – Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) = UTC −04:00 (second Sun. in March → first Sun. in Nov.)  

3. London, United Kingdom  
   • Zone name: Greenwich Mean Time / British Summer Time  
     – GMT  = UTC ±00:00 (late Oct. → late Mar.)  
     – BST  = UTC +01:00 (last Sun. in Mar. → last Sun. in Oct.)  

4. Tokyo, Japan  
   • Zone name: Japan Standard Time (JST)  
   • UTC offset: UTC +09:00 year-round  
   • Daylight-saving time: Not used  

How they line up (think in terms of UTC):

           HNL      NYC      LON      TYO
Standard   −10      −05       0       +9
Summer*    −10      −04      +1       +9
(*“Summer” = when NYC is on EDT and London on BST.)

Rule-of-thumb differences
────────────────────────
• NYC ↔ London: 5 h apart in winter (EST vs GMT), 4 h in summer (EDT vs BST).  
• NYC ↔ Honolulu: 5 h apart in winter, 6 h in summer (because only NYC shifts).  
• London ↔ Honolulu: 10 h apart in winter, 11 h in summer.  
• London ↔ Tokyo: 9 h apart in winter, 8 h in summer.  
• Tokyo ↔ Honolulu: 19 h apart in winter, 20 h in summer (nearly a full day).  

Mental conversion hack
1. Start from UTC (or London in winter).  
2. Move west for negatives, east for positives:  
   – Honolulu −10 → subtract 10 h.  
   – New York −5 (or −4 when on EDT).  
   – London 0 (or +1 on BST).  
   – Tokyo +9.  
3. Or pick one city as your anchor and add/subtract the differences above.

Example (mid-July, so NYC on EDT, London on BST):  
• 14:00 in London → 09:00 in NYC → 03:00 in Honolulu (same day) → 22:00 in Tokyo (already into the next night).

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

• Köppen class: Cfb (temperate oceanic).  
• Typical mean temp: 5 °C in January | 18–19 °C in July.  
• Annual mean temp: ≈ 11 °C.  
• Annual precipitation: ~620 mm, spread fairly evenly; driest late-spring, wettest autumn.  
• Rainy days (≥ 1 mm): ~110 per yr.  
• Sunshine: ≈ 1 600 h/yr (cloudier than many European capitals).  
• Record high: 40.2 °C (19 Jul 2022, Heathrow – U.K. record).  
• Record low: –16.1 °C (1 Jan 1962, Northolt).  
• Prevailing SW winds off the Atlantic keep winters mild; snow is light (≈ 7 days with any snow per yr).

Paris (Parc Montsouris – inland-oceanic)
• Köppen class: Cfb (oceanic with warmer, drier summers than London).  
• Typical mean temp: 5 °C in January | 20–21 °C in July.  
• Annual mean temp: ≈ 12 °C.  
• Annual precipitation: ~640 mm; no real dry season, but late-spring is a touch wetter.  
• Rainy days: ~105 per yr.  
• Sunshine: ≈ 1 660 h/yr.  
• Record high: 42.6 °C (25 Jul 2019 – all-time for Paris).  
• Record low: –23.9 °C (10 Dec 1879).  
• Urban heat-island effect bumps summer nights 1 – 2 °C above surrounding countryside.

• Köppen class: Cfa (borderline humid subtropical – hotter summers, occasional Mediterranean influence).  
• Typical mean temp: 3 °C in January | 22 °C in July.  
• Annual mean temp: ≈ 13 °C.  
• Annual precipitation: ~840 mm; two maxima: late-spring convective storms and an October “autumn monsoon.”

• Record high: 40.5 °C (31 Jul 2022).  
• Record low: –24.6 °C (7 Feb 2012).  
• Mistral & northern “bise” can drop winter wind-chills; Foehn effects occasionally warm overnight.

Quick comparisons & curiosities
• Warmth: Lyon > Paris > London for both summer highs and annual mean.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

All of them report to the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) and/or to the aviation-weather METAR network, so their data can be found on most weather sites and apps.

London, United Kingdom
• EGLL – London Heathrow Airport (WMO 03772) ‑ the city’s primary long-term climate station.  
• EGLC – London City Airport (WMO 03771) – in Docklands; good for central/east-end conditions.  
• EGKK – London Gatwick Airport (WMO 03776) – south of the city but widely used in forecasts.  
• EGWU – RAF Northolt (WMO 03773) – north-west London.  
• KEW / Kew Gardens (WMO 03768) – Met Office automatic station used for climatology.  

Paris, France
• LFPG – Paris–Charles-de-Gaulle Airport (WMO 07157) – northeast of the city.  
• LFPO – Paris–Orly Airport (WMO 07149) – south of the city, long climate record.  
• LFPB – Paris–Le Bourget Airport (WMO 07156) – business airport just inside the A86 ring road.  
• 07150 – Paris-Montsouris Observatory – historic urban climate reference since 1873.  
• LFPV – Vélizy / Villacoublay Air Base (WMO 07155) – southwestern suburbs.  

Lyon, France
• LFLL – Lyon–Saint-Exupéry Airport (WMO 07481) – main international airport, 20 km east of centre.  
• LFLY – Lyon–Bron Airport (WMO 07480) – older airfield, still the city’s official climate station.  
• 07478 – Lyon–Parilly (Météo-France auto station in the eastern suburbs).  
• 07485 – Sain-Rambert-d’Albon (often used to represent the lower Rhône valley near Lyon).  
• LFHJ – Lyon–Corbas aerodrome (automatic METAR; popular for glider and aero-club weather).

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.
