function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

2. Rolling low-level clouds & strange lighting:  
   The outflow lifted the very moist surface air, briefly giving you ragged low clouds and fog that can look dramatic under city lights or the approaching dawn. With breaks above that layer you get fast-moving cloud ceilings and odd gaps where the stars reappear—hence the “funky” look.

Anything to watch for
• If the wind suddenly shifts NW again and you smell “rain-cooled” air, another small cell may be nearby—head indoors if you see lightning.

When a storm collapses, the cold downdraft hits the ground and spreads out as a gust front; that’s the sudden wind shift and drop in temperature/humidity you felt.

2. Rolling low-level clouds & strange lighting:  
   The outflow lifted the very moist surface air, briefly giving you ragged low clouds and fog that can look dramatic under city lights or the approaching dawn. With breaks above that layer you get fast-moving cloud ceilings and odd gaps where the stars reappear—hence the “funky” look.

3. Rapid clearing:  
   Once the outflow pushes through, the sky can go from overcast to clear in minutes, because the small storm used up its local supply of instability.

Will it keep doing it?
• Short term (next 1–2 h): Things should continue calming down; radar shows the tiny cell already east of the city and weakening.  
• Dawn to mid-morning: Another brief shower can’t be ruled out—the atmosphere is still humid and marginally unstable—but widespread storms look unlikely until the afternoon heating starts.  
• Later today: Expect scattered showers and isolated storms after noon, especially if the sun comes out and temperatures reach the mid-20 °C range.

Anything to watch for
• If the wind suddenly shifts NW again and you smell “rain-cooled” air, another small cell may be nearby—head indoors if you see lightning.

• Tokyo Haneda Airport – Station ID RJTT  
  ‑ Roughly 15 km south-southeast of the Imperial Palace (central Tokyo).  
  ‑ Offers the full Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) data set: temperature, wind, pressure, visibility, precipitation, cloud ceiling, METAR/SYNOP reports every hour (and more frequent aviation updates).  
  ‑ If you use an app or site that lets you enter a station ID, just plug in “RJTT”.

A few practical ways to read Haneda data:
1. Aviation/METAR sites (AviationWeather.gov, Windy, Ventusky, Meteostat, etc.) – enter RJTT.
2. JMA’s English site (Data & Statistics → Hourly Data → Haneda).
3. Many general-purpose weather apps default to RJTT when you enable “Tokyo” as the city.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

PARIS, FRANCE  
• Standard time zone: Central European Time (CET) → UTC + 1  
• Daylight-saving time (last Sunday in March – last Sunday in October): Central European Summer Time (CEST) → UTC + 2  

LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM  
• Standard time zone: Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) → UTC + 0  
• Daylight-saving time (last Sunday in March – last Sunday in October): British Summer Time (BST) → UTC + 1  

Quick rule of thumb  
• During the winter (roughly late October – late March) Paris is one hour ahead of London (e.g., when it’s 12:00 p.m. in London it’s 13:00 in Paris).  
• During the summer (late March – late October) both cities move their clocks forward by one hour, so Paris remains one hour ahead of London (e.g., 12:00 p.m. London → 13:00 Paris).  

Clock-setting tips  
• When you travel from London to Paris, add one hour to your watch; travelling the other way, subtract one hour.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.name: find_nearby_stations
function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.name: get_current_location
function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.name: get_latitude_longitude
function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.

function.description: This endpoint provides a list of nearby weather stations for a given geographical location.

lat_long.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude.

returns.description: A list of dictionaries about the various stations near the specified location.

function.description: Returns the current location. ONLY use this if the user has not provided an explicit location in the query.

returns.description: The current location as a string (e.g., 'Austin').

function.name: get_current_time_at_location
function.description: Returns the current time at a given location.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the location.

returns.description: The current time at the specified location.

function.name: get_hourly_observation
function.description: Returns hourly observations between start_time and end_time.

station_id.description: The station_id for the station of interest.

time_zone.description: The timezone string ID for the location.

returns.description: A list of hourly observations for the specified station and timespan.

function.description: Given a city name, this function provides the latitude and longitude of the specific location.

location.description: The name of the location (e.g., 'Austin', 'Austin Airport').

returns.description: A list containing the latitude and longitude of the location.

function.name: get_nearest_station_id
function.description: Given a list of nearby stations, returns the one nearest to you and provides the system ID for it alone.

nearby_stations.description: A list of nearby stations in dictionary format.

returns.description: The station_id for the nearest station in the list.

function.name: get_timezone
function.description: This function retrieves the timezone for a given latitude and longitude.

lat_long.description: The latitude and longitude of the area.

returns.description: The timezone string ID for the specified location.

function.name: subtract_time_delta
function.description: Subtracts a time delta from the date part of a given date time string and returns the new date string.

date_time_str.description: The date time string in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.

delta_days.description: Number of days to subtract. Must be greater than 0.

returns.description: The new date string after subtracting the delta.
